_about: Published group means for every model in this suite, as data rather than as
constants in code. shared/analyse.py reads this file; nothing here is
computed. Each block records where the number came from, so a disagreement
can be traced to a source instead of to a memory.
Group means are unweighted over datasets: every graph counts once, whatever
its query count. That is how all four papers form these figures.
'primary' names the target criterion B judges against. Where a model has
both a paper figure and a figure the code repository measured itself, the
repository one is primary: it is the implementation being run here.

repo.source: repos/ultra/README.md at pin 427966ad, table row 'ULTRA (3g) PyG'
repo.note: the PyG rewrite's own measured figures. README states these were run on a single RTX 3090, PyTorch 2.1, PyG 2.4, CUDA 11.8, using run_many.py -- the same script this project drives.

paper.source: arXiv 2310.04562; reproduced in repos/ultra/README.md as row 'ULTRA (3g) Paper'
paper.note: produced with the TorchDrug implementation, which lives in the separate repository DeepGraphLearning/ultra_torchdrug (README line 31). Not the code run here. README line 363 states the preprint numbers came from a TorchDrug-trained model.

paper.caption: Average zero-shot and fine-tuned link prediction MRR and Hits@10 over 51 KGs.
paper.note: pretrained on FB15k237, WN18RR and CoDEx Medium. The released ckpts/motif_3g.pth is taken to be this row's checkpoint; the repository ships no other 3-graph checkpoint.
entity prediction only. TRIX trains and releases relation prediction as a separate model and checkpoint, which this suite does not measure.

relation.source: measured in this repository, 2026-08-27: relation_prediction.pth over all 41 inductive graphs, GPU, seed 1024, ranks in ranks-relation/trix/
relation.protocol: UNFILTERED, per TRIX's own run_relation.py: other true relations between the same pair stay in the candidate set. Candidates are the direct relations only. State this on every relation table.
relation.cross_check: FLOCK paper Table 11 quotes TRIX per graph; nine spot-checked inductive graphs (FB/WN/NELL v1, FBIngram:25, WKIngram:25, NLIngram:0, WikiTopicsMT1:tax, Metafam, FBNELL) match to the printed third decimal (max |delta| 0.001).

paper.caption: Zero-shot results of Semma. Zero-shot link prediction MRR and Hits@10 reported over 54 KGs averaged over 5 runs.
paper.note: AVERAGED OVER 5 RUNS. This project runs one seed (1024), so a difference within run-to-run spread is expected and the tolerance below is not a like-for-like test. SEMMA-Hybrid is named in the paper but not released, so it is out of scope. Note also that this table's own ULTRA baseline row reads 0.428/0.570 for ind_e, which is neither figure ULTRA's README gives.
